business.name: Wix Test Site
business.tone: clear, confident, benefit-led, premium but practical

design.typography: high readability, clear headings, body 16px+ on phone

responsive.policy: expanded desktop/tablet/phone/breakpoint matrix required; phone is primary pass/fail; large desktop/27-inch and breakpoint edges are also blocking for professional completion when layout breaks
mustPass: section order makes sense on phone

conversion.note: Policy pages should reduce confusion without pretending to replace legal advice.

seo.robots: index only if client wants public policy indexed; no aggressive SEO copy

legal.disclaimer: Generated policy content is not legal advice and must be reviewed against jurisdiction, business model, payment/refund/data practices, and client obligations before publishing.

required: responsive-audit PASS with expanded viewport matrix
SEO/content sanity proof PASS where page-level change applies
rollback note or restore path captured

gates.label: Editor/preview inspection
requiredEvidence: preview URL or preview-rendered page proof

gates.label: Published Wix-domain inspection
requiredEvidence: published Wix-domain URL, not only editor or preview URL
browser-rendered screenshots as a real user sees the site
responsive-audit result against the published Wix-domain URL

twoStepQa.completionRule: A Wix website/change cannot be called done until both editor/preview inspection and published Wix-domain inspection pass, or a named gate is explicitly BLOCKED with the missing proof.

seo: title/meta/H1/internal links where page-level change applies

rollback: keep previous policy page until reviewed
remove draft page or restore previous policy
use Wix site history if needed
assumptions: Generated copy/design is a professional starting point and must be adapted to real client facts before publish.
Phone experience is the primary pass/fail gate because most visitors are expected to arrive on mobile.
Published Wix-domain proof is required separately from editor/preview proof because Wix preview/editor rendering can differ from the real published site.
No domain, payment, order, booking, or publish action is implied by this generated spec.
